corrections.reason: The negative prefix አይ- in አይተውልሽም is a single word split across the line wrap, with slight kerning between አ and ይ.
Both visually on the right leg of the second ሠ and grammatically in Classical Ge'ez (plural subject ሊቃነ ካህናት ወጸሐፍት), the verb is 3rd person masculine plural ወየኃሥሡ (Luke 19:47).
